BUILT FROM bushel probe run 90062058376, 2026-08-29 02:55 UTC. The probe loaded https://chsag.com/grain/cash-bids/ in the runner's Chromium and read the response that page's own widget asked api.bushelpowered.com for: 15 row(s) at this location, commodities Yellow Corn. locationId is the location UUID the payload itself carries, which is the only thing that identifies a Bushel location -- and the reason the sharded sweep could never supply it: discover.mjs keys a Bushel response on its last path segment, which is "GetBidsList" for every operator alive. cashRounding is MEASURED, not guessed: floor-cent explains ALL 15 rows, residuals -0.5c, -0.25c, 0c. bands are DEFAULT_BANDS values from lib/board.mjs, copied, for the commodities this location actually quotes. The hrw/hrs/sww entries were added to DEFAULT_BANDS earlier tonight after 47 wheat rows across the DTN probe were found to match no band at all and were being silently withheld. state is null. The Bushel payload carries a location name and a UUID and no address at all -- the probe prints "NOT IN THE PAYLOAD" for every one of the fourteen locations it read. It has not been looked up and will not be invented. SAME BOARD, DIFFERENT DOMAIN. This location was read from chsrochester.com, whose board returned eight locations of which SEVEN are already live as sources/chsag-*.json with byte-identical locationIds (Fairmont is a33375fe-cbce-4927-88fe-b5398968b4ed on both). chsrochester.com and chsag.com serve one Bushel board. This file therefore uses the chsag.com browserPage its seven siblings already use, so the board keeps one writer and the duplicate guard in test/sources.test.mjs stays meaningful.

LOCATED (2026-10-08): Absolute Energy is a delivery point at another company's plant. Its address, 1372 State Line Rd, St. Ansgar, IA 50472, comes from the Barchart directory row for this delivery point on CHS's own board (CHS - Ag Terminals, "Absolute Energy", St Ansgar, IA 50472) and a company directory listing (web search 2026-10-08); a carbon-storage project database puts it in Mitchell County, IA. The state is corrected from MN (inferred from the operator's other locations) to IA. No coordinate is set. The coordinate is the centroid of ZIP 50472 (St. Ansgar) from the same USPS table geocodes/zip-towns.json is built from, at town precision: it is not the plant's own point (no street-level coordinate for it was available), but it puts this Iowa delivery point in Iowa where test/state-outliers.test.mjs can measure it.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the same feed their own website reads. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.
